idea-plugin.name: Redacto
idea-plugin.description:
Anonymize selected code or console output on this device, and restore the original values in an AI reply. Select text in an editor or a Run/Debug console, right-click → Anonymize with Redacto: the Redacto tool window shows the original next to the anonymized text and saves it to History. Your code is never changed.
Local builds only — this plugin is not published to the Marketplace.

action.description: Show the selection anonymized in the Redacto tool window (the selection is not changed)
Show the clipboard text (e.g. copied from the terminal) anonymized in the Redacto tool window
